title: Choose Coop's new operator console
question: Three production-level directions from the current flow and Mobbin research. Choose the one Coop should become.

options.label: Execution Dossier
options.lineage: official run records, evidence folios, and modern platform inspectors
options.thesis: Every run becomes one legible dossier from queued request to portable proof.
options.viewport: A run ledger, selected execution, and permanent proof folio share one calm three-part workspace.
options.risk: The right folio must collapse cleanly on smaller laptops or the center can feel compressed.

raised.raise: The run, lifecycle, and proof folio now form one fixed cross-check sweep.
Cancelled and failed evidence remains visible instead of disappearing.
Amber and red are reserved for genuine caution and failure.
The transition from live run to sealed proof becomes Coop's signature moment.

options.label: Three-Pane Operations Desk
options.lineage: Databricks run detail, Snowflake workspaces, and Hume job records
options.thesis: A dense queue, output-first workspace, and pinned evidence inspector make every operator action immediate.
options.viewport: A 300px queue, broad execution workspace, and 300px boundary inspector fill the frame edge to edge.
options.risk: It is the most familiar platform pattern and therefore the least ownable without excellent evidence details.

options.label: Night Flight Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six fixed truths give the operator a practiced scan path through a run.
options.viewport: A fixed constellation of run, policy, output, and evidence instruments.
options.case: Operator identification holds, but round gauges misrepresent event-ledger and evidence data.
options.risk: It would repeat the dark technical costume the redesign is meant to leave behind.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: carbon-copy coupons, baggage tags, and route manifests
options.thesis: A run tears through requested, active, and sealed evidence coupons without losing history.
options.viewport: The selected run unfolds as a sequence of retained operational coupons.
options.case: Durable state maps well, but the paper metaphor slows routine monitoring.
options.kept: Nothing disappears when cancelled; it is visibly voided.
options.risk: Literal ephemera would turn proof into decoration.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.lineage: bitmap scrollers and depth-ranked work queues
options.thesis: Brightness and depth pull exactly one run to the foreground.
options.viewport: Unboxed queue layers advance and recede around one bright selected run.
options.case: Foreground rank is clear, but the form recreates terminal cosplay.
options.risk: It would look deliberately retro instead of operationally current.

options.label: Miura Evidence Sheet
options.thesis: Requested policy unfolds into observed controls and proof through one coupled geometry.
options.viewport: One linked field expands from request through execution to evidence.
options.case: Causality is strong, but folding geometry obscures familiar controls.
options.kept: Linked fields should reveal policy-to-evidence causality.
options.risk: The diagram would become the product instead of serving the work.

options.label: Crisis Wall
options.thesis: Conditions and limits announce themselves with absolute visual force.
options.viewport: A severe framed wall of execution conditions and counters.
options.case: The alarms are clear, but constant crisis language destroys trust calibration.
options.kept: Reserve alarm colors for real exceptions.
options.risk: Every normal run would look like an emergency.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: A run is cut from policy, worked live, and sealed into a durable block of evidence.
options.viewport: Execution moves through stacked white blocks with deep blue evidence gaps.
options.case: The material is memorable, but it does not identify the operator audience or familiar task.
options.risk: It would sacrifice daily usability for visual novelty.

canonCard.label: Canonical Platform Console
canonCard.thesis: A familiar enterprise run table and detail drawer, executed at current platform quality.
canonCard.viewport: A factual navigation rail, run table, and selected-run drawer use the arrangement operators already expect.
canonCard.risk: It is intentionally indistinguishable from neighboring developer platforms.
